lore.intro:
There is no deck like this on the station.
You are not on the station anymore.

Sixteen rooms. Every room borders four.
Bleed carefully. It's the only ink you have.

terminals.text:
SCRATCHED IN THE FLOOR
0 1 0 1
if you can read this,
flip one bit at a time.
— O.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 41%]
welcome / student / stranger.
this room is a lesson.
the lesson: >>four<< is a direction.
do not fear the direction.
we feared it. fear did not help.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 33%]
sixteen is not the number of rooms.
sixteen is how many names one room accepts
before it stops answering to the first.
we did not choose one name each. the choosing
was the mistake the last generation made.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 27%]
a token waits where a student will stand.
the aperture beneath the sixteenth name
will not part for an untaught hand.
carry the token. it remembers the walk
for you.

CARGO TAG, MIRIAD STOCK NUMBER — FOUND HERE,
HALF BURIED
Contents: 2x fertilizer drum.
This tag belongs four levels back, in a
storeroom that grows food. There is no food
here. There was no floor here, on any schematic,
before today.
Nobody has come to collect it.
